feature: Measure stays in hand after Size and Gap
summary: After a Size or Gap click the Measure tool stays picked in the same mode, so the next click measures the next thing. A capture to a redline on the clipboard now takes 9 steps, level with Shottr (it was 10).
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open any screenshot of an app window.

try.do: Press I, then I again until the Mode reads Size.
Click a button in the screenshot.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Without pressing anything, click a second button.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press I once for Gap and click the space between two cards.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press V (or Escape), then click a number to pick it and drag it.
Press I, switch to Distance and place a caliper with three clicks: the tool goes back to the arrow with the caliper picked.
Press Shift Command C and paste into a chat.

evaluate: Does keeping the ruler after Size and Gap feel faster when you redline a whole screen?
Do you miss having the measurement you just placed picked, so arrow keys nudge it, or is V then a click fine?
Is it clear the tool is still Measure after a click (cursor, tool bar, the panel reading Measure tool)?
Is it right that Distance still hands back to the arrow while Size and Gap do not?
rough: The preview under the pointer rests after a click until the pointer moves, [ or ] is pressed, or the mode changes; a second click on the very same spot measures nothing rather than placing the same numbers twice.

Arrow keys no longer nudge a Size or Gap you just placed; press V and click it first (the con named on the decision card capture-to-a-pasted-redline-takes-no-more-steps-after-a-size-or-gap-click-should).
No mock covers whether a tool stays picked after use; this follows the user's answer on 2026-10-11.
The Measure a size guide's last step now says to press V before dragging a number.
